Complete Guide to Passport & ID Photo Maker

Obtaining passport, visa, and government identity photos at commercial studios can be expensive and time-consuming. Commercial online services often charge recurring subscriptions or watermark your images. TECHTIS Passport & ID Photo Maker provides a completely free, 100% private in-browser solution compliant with international civil aviation standards (ICAO Doc 9303).

Our interactive workspace includes verified presets for major international jurisdictions:

  • India Passport / OCI / Visa: Standard 35 × 45 mm color photo with 70-80% face coverage.
  • United States Visa / Green Card: Exact 2 × 2 inch (50.8 × 50.8 mm) square photo with white background.
  • UK / Schengen / European Union: 35 × 45 mm biometric portrait with chin-to-crown height between 32 mm and 36 mm.
  • Universal Student & Employee ID: 30 × 40 mm portrait format suitable for company badges and campus cards.

Our biometric face alignment overlay displays head oval and eye level guides so you can position your portrait with millimeter precision. When finished, you can export a single high-resolution 300 DPI photograph or generate a multi-up A4 printable PDF sheet containing 8 neatly tiled photos with cutting border lines.

Printing Tip: When printing the generated A4 PDF sheet, always select "Actual Size" or 100% Scale in your printer dialogue. Never choose "Fit to page", which alters physical dimensions.

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about Passport & ID Photo Maker and privacy

What are the dimensions for an Indian passport photo?
The official specification is 35 mm in width by 45 mm in height, with the face covering 70% to 80% of the photo area.
What are the dimensions for a US visa or passport photo?
The US Department of State requires a 2 x 2 inch (51 x 51 mm) square photograph with a plain white or off-white background.
How should I print the A4 print sheet?
Print on 4x6 inch or A4 glossy photo paper using your home printer or a local photo lab. Crucially, set printer scale to "Actual Size" or 100% (do NOT select "Fit to Printable Area").
Are my private portrait photos uploaded to any server?
Never. All cropping, biometric overlay rendering, and PDF sheet generation take place exclusively inside your browser memory.
